description: This file contains unit tests for Celery tasks related to the opportunity module in the Django CRM project, specifically testing asynchronous email sending functionality using Celery's eager execution mode.

classes.name: TestCeleryTasks
classes.description: A unit test class that verifies the proper functioning of the send_email_to_assigned_user Celery task within the opportunity context, ensuring that email tasks are executed correctly under test conditions.

methods.name: test_celery_tasks(self)
methods.description: Test method that runs the send_email_to_assigned_user task with specific input data and checks that the task's state is 'SUCCESS', effectively verifying that the Celery task executes properly under test settings.
